items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the image of a point of finite type under a surjective morphism of finite type of algebraic stacks is again a point of finite type (author lemma at source lines 3742-3747, label lemma-finite-type-points-surjective-morphism). The proof (source lines 3749-3764) chooses presentations of the source and target adapted to the given point, applies the corresponding statement for schemes and returns through the characterization of points of finite type by presentations (proof lines 3749-3763). The choice of presentations and the return to the stack-level characterization are the content. H2.
